name: Elwynn: a ghost released in Jasperlode Mine reaches the Tower of Azora Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies inside Jasperlode Mine (zone 10126, in its eastern tunnel (-9051.2,-551.2,63.6)) releases at the Tower of Azora graveyard 1468 (-9564.74,-605.882,58.4409), about 520 yards west, not at Northshire 105 (-8935.33,-188.646,80.4165), which serves only Northshire Valley and sits about 380 yards away. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Tower of Azora graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
